product.summary: Standalone OKX Wallet mobile application separated from the primary OKX exchange app and distributed on iOS and Android.
product.notes: The standalone OKX Wallet App was explicitly announced as available on 2025-04-16. This does not define the earlier entity-level wallet launch date.

events.title: OKX Wallet added Pharos mainnet support
events.description: OKX announced on 2026-04-29 that OKX Wallet had completed Pharos mainnet integration from day one, enabling users to manage Pharos assets and interact with ecosystem dApps directly in the wallet.

evidence.title: Announcing the new OKX Wallet app
evidence.notes: First-party announcement states that the standalone OKX Wallet App was available on the App Store and Google Play on 2025-04-16.

evidence.title: How do I download / update the OKX Wallet app?
evidence.notes: Official OKX help documentation, updated 2026-08-05, identifies the official OKX Wallet download path and current Android distribution/update routes. This is used only as current availability/support evidence, not as a launch or lifecycle-event timestamp.

evidence.title: Announcement on OKX Wallet's Support for Pharos Mainnet Launch
evidence.notes: First-party OKX announcement states wallet integration was completed from Pharos mainnet day one.
